context.body: The birth follows David’s judgment, the first child’s death, and Bathsheba’s grief.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Bathsheba bears a son named Solomon; the LORD loves him and sends the name Jedidiah through Nathan.
observations.label: Solomon is born and named Jedidiah: action

observations.body: David comforts Bathsheba, and the child survives after the death narrated immediately before him.
observations.label: Solomon is born and named Jedidiah: response

observations.body: Solomon · the LORD loved him · Jedidiah
observations.label: Words in 2 Samuel 12:24–25

payload.posture: Read 2 Samuel 12:24–25 as promise and succession evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The scene joins love and naming to a household still marked by the preceding loss.
payload.title: Solomon is born and named Jedidiah
